tutorial.actions.body.en: Attack damages enemies. Thwart removes threat from schemes. Recover is only available in alter-ego form and heals your identity.
tutorial.actions.body.zh: 攻击会对敌人造成伤害。化解会从密谋上移除威胁。恢复只能在凡人身份下使用，用来治疗你的身份。

tutorial.defense.body.en: When attacked, you may defend with your hero or an ally. Tough status cards prevent all damage from one hit, but are discarded after use.
tutorial.defense.body.zh: 受到攻击时，你可以用英雄或盟友防御。不屈状态卡能防止一次攻击的全部伤害，但使用后会被弃掉。

tutorial.endTurn.body.en: Click End turn. You will discard down to your hand limit if needed, then draw back up for the next round.
tutorial.endTurn.body.zh: 点击“结束回合”。如果手牌超过上限，系统会要求你弃牌；随后会为下一轮补牌。

tutorial.endTurn.title.en: End your turn when you are done

tutorial.enemy.body.en: The villain schemes or attacks, then reveals boost cards that add icons to the activation. Main schemes advancing too far can defeat the players.
tutorial.enemy.body.zh: 反派会进行密谋或攻击，然后揭示增效牌，为行动增加图标。主线密谋推进过快会让玩家失败。

tutorial.enemy.title.en: Villain phase: schemes and boost cards
tutorial.enemy.title.zh: 反派阶段：密谋与增效牌

tutorial.resources.body.en: When a card has a cost, choose enough hand cards to generate resource icons. Energy, Genius, and Strength each produce two matching icons; other cards produce one.
tutorial.resources.body.zh: 当卡牌有费用时，选择足够的手牌来产生资源图标。能量、天才、力量各自产生两个对应图标，其他牌通常产生一个。

tutorial.resources.title.en: Paying costs: select cards as resources
tutorial.resources.title.zh: 支付费用：选择手牌当资源

tutorial.turn.body.en: During your player turn, click cards on the board or choices at the bottom. Cards cost resources; basic powers let your hero attack, thwart, recover, or defend.
tutorial.turn.body.zh: 在玩家回合里，点击棋盘上的卡牌或底部选项。打牌需要支付资源；英雄可以使用基础能力：攻击、化解、恢复或防御。

tutorial.turn.title.en: Your turn: play cards or use basic powers
tutorial.turn.title.zh: 你的回合：打牌或使用基础能力
